mapper.select: SELECT t.name AS name, COUNT(tt.task_id) AS count FROM tag t JOIN task_tag tt ON tt.tag_id = t.id AND tt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id JOIN task tk ON tk.id = tt.task_id AND tk.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tk.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY t.id, t.name HAVING count > 0 ORDER BY count DESC, t.name

SELECT t.name AS name, COUNT(tt.task_id) AS count FROM tag t JOIN task_tag tt ON tt.tag_id = t.id AND tt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id JOIN task tk ON tk.id = tt.task_id AND tk.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tk.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = tk.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = tk.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none') GROUP BY t.id, t.name HAVING count > 0 ORDER BY count DESC, t.name
SELECT id, workspace_id, name, created_at FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, workspace_id, name, created_at FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (id, workspace_id, name) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{name})
INSERT IGNORE INTO task_tag (task_id, tag_id, workspace_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tagId}, #{workspaceId})

INSERT IGNORE INTO task_tag (task_id, tag_id, workspace_id) VALUES
(#{r.taskId}, #{r.tagId}, #{workspaceId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM task_tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id IN #{taskId}
